verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official AvaTax MCP server whose tools cover tax calculation, transaction lookup, nexus definitions, and AI tax-code recommendations. It shows a plain-English example prompt ("Calculate tax for a $100 sale to a customer in California..."). The trial also advertises the Avi Agent and conversational queries for exploring transactions, so natural-language operation is clearly delivered at the core. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language flows work as described, detailed documentation of the Avi Agent's capabilities, and clarity on how much of the product beyond read and calculate operations (e.g., nexus creation, filing) can be driven by natural language.
